claims.text: Anaplastic cancer with BRAF V600E (about 45%): dabrafenib plus trametinib, often with an immune checkpoint inhibitor, before surgery.
claims.quote: Approximately 45% of anaplastic tumors harbor a BRAF V600E mutation. In one study, patients who received targeted therapy with dabrafenib plus trametinib and, in most cases, an immune checkpoint inhibitor prior to surgery had a 1-year survival rate of 93%.
